entities.name: Estrella Durá Ferrandis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Estrella Durá Ferrandis is a Spanish Professor of Psychology at the University of Valencia and became a Member of the European Parliament in 2019. She belongs to the Progressive Alliance of Socialists and Democrats (S&D) in the European Parliament and represents the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE).
